0022600004.text: Both the Minnesota Timberwolves and Miami Heat open their 2026-27 seasons in this regular-season game, with Minnesota on the road. The Timberwolves will be without Donte DiVincenzo, who is out after Achilles surgery, and Rocco Zikarsky is day-to-day for an undisclosed reason and is a game-time decision. Miami also has three players listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions: Bam Adebayo (groin), Dru Smith (calf strain), and Pelle Larsson (illness).
